# Swiffer

> The AI-powered WhatsApp CRM platform for sales, support, marketing, and automation. Self-hosted, multi-tenant, enterprise-ready.

Swiffer is a modern WhatsApp CRM built for teams that live on WhatsApp. It combines a shared inbox, contacts CRM, broadcast campaigns, automation workflows, and an AI Studio (reply suggestions, thread summaries, chatbot builder, campaign copy) into a single platform. Provider-agnostic (Meta Cloud API, on-prem, or mock), multi-tenant workspaces, role-based access, and self-hosting via Docker.
